programs.title: Underworld: Evolution
programs.desc: The saga that has stunned audiences for years for its special effects and creatures from other worlds is now back with more vampires and werewolves. These have evolved in the human universe but are still fighting for power. In this new story, the beautiful vampire, Selene, is still trying to get over the massacre of her family, a memory that follows her always. But now she discovers who is responsible for the deaths, and intends to take revenge. Her ally is Michael, who is still unconvinced about having been turned in to a hybrid.
